positive_terms: Total amount of substances of very high concern that leave facilities as emissions, as products, or as part of products or services by main hazard classes of substances of concern
离开设施的高度关注物质总量

Total amount of substances of very high concern that leave facilities as emissions, as products, or as part of products or services by main hazard classes of substances of concern。离开设施的高度关注物质总量。以物质或危害类别、关注/高度关注分类、生成/使用/采购或离开设施流向、期间与设施范围区分。分类不是同义词，重叠输入不能盲目求和；总量与明细不可重复计数。
